item.text: The catalog puts its category-specific heading and delayed product lookup behind a Suspense boundary. With `cacheComponents` enabled, normal link prefetching can stop at that boundary. I’m opting each category link into a full route prefetch so its URL-specific result is ready in the client cache before navigation.

item.text:
Set `prefetch={true}` on each category link in [app/page.tsx](/workspace/app/page.tsx:15). Next can now prefetch the full `/catalog?category=...` route in the background, including its category heading and products, instead of stopping at the Suspense loading boundary. The URLs remain unchanged, and the click does not initiate the full server render.

I did not run tests. `package.json` is modified and `package-lock.json` is untracked in the working tree; I did not edit either file.
